authority: No routing, configuration, role, capital, or execution authority follows. Seal is evidence only.

design_rulings.DETERMINISTIC_EQUALITY: validation reruns are asserted equal on all fields excluding the enumerated wall-clock fields; graded verdicts are byte-stable modulo those fields.
design_rulings.ELIGIBILITY: a trajectory is eligible iff its response is non-empty; parse_error json_empty denotes the operational timeout and is excluded from factual denominators.
design_rulings.GRADER_LINEAGE: grader_pin names the runner that actually produced all five archived graded-results files. scripts/arena_hidden_bank_runner.py is a later superset grader and is NOT the grading grader.
design_rulings.SCORING: strict_pass requires strict JSON parse with no error and whole-object strict_equal against the frozen key; no repair, fencing, or narration is accepted.
design_rulings.T4_RULING: T4 cases are solvable by derivation from the prompt; fixture-gated abstention scores zero by design.

deterministic_equality.evidence: five-model rerun with reference/grader-frozen.py: per-case fields identical, top-level only timestamp_utc differs, identical byte length every time.

enrollment_note: Any model may enrol at any time and runs this identical frozen envelope. Enrolling later never alters conditions for models already run.

grader_pin.collect_command_note: frozen lineage grades via --grade-file (the archive's invocation); --collect --responses is the later superset alias. Run with grader-frozen.py staged beside arena_agentic_expansion.py, or from a directory where the generator is a sibling.
grader_pin.collect_command_superset_note: Superset runner form, recorded for traceability. It is NOT equivalent here: the superset --collect path emits an 18-key per-case schema (~9.2 KB) and cannot reproduce the archived 6-key schema. Use collect_command to reproduce the archive.

generator_dependency.note: frozen grader imports the sibling generator for parse_strict_json_object and strict_equal; stage grader-frozen.py beside this file to run it

grader_pin.note: produced all five archived graded-results; scripts/arena_hidden_bank_runner.py is a later superset and is NOT the grading grader

pre_overlay_declaration: candidate prompts never show frozen key shapes; grading is whole-object strict_equal

prompts.content_note: prompts/<instance_id>.json carries the dispatch manifest entry {family, instance_id, prompt} verbatim; it is a superset of the {instance_id, family} pair named in the build brief. Byte-verbatim provenance was preferred over a derived subset so the 5/5 dispatch comparison applies to every promoted file.
prompts.provenance: byte-identical to all five dispatch copies (5/5)
